mapper.insert: insert into payment_writeoff (corpid, supplier_id, writeoff_no, payment_id, payable_id, writeoff_date, amount, status, remark, creator_id, modify_id, del, add_time, update_time) values (#{corpid}, #{supplierId}, #{writeoffNo}, #{paymentId}, #{payableId}, #{writeoffDate}, #{amount}, 1, #{remark}, #{creatorId}, #{modifyId}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, corpid, supplier_id, writeoff_no, payment_id, payable_id, writeoff_date, amount, status, reversed_time, remark, creator_id, modify_id from payment_writeoff where corpid = #{conditionMap.corpid} and del = 0 order by id desc limit #{conditionMap.offset}, #{conditionMap.limit}
select count(1) from payment_writeoff where corpid = #{conditionMap.corpid} and del = 0
